name: youspot
description: YouSpot, the AI-native personal CRM. Two MCP servers (one over a member's own CRM, one over the public docs), three agent skills, and a CLI.

youspot.description: Read and write the signed-in member's contacts, companies, notes and files, plus their connected Gmail, Google Calendar, HubSpot, LinkedIn, Slack and X accounts. OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; initialize and tools/list need no credential.

youspot-docs.description: Search and read YouSpot's public pages and developer documentation. No credential at all.

youspot.description: Ask about YouSpot, read its docs, and list or call its MCP tools from the terminal.
